title: Reach the description drag handle to begin reordering a paragraph
steps: Hover over the first description paragraph to reveal its drag handle.
Move the pointer slowly left toward the handle, pausing in the gutter.
If the handle remains reachable, acquire it and begin dragging the paragraph.

video_guide.summary: The handle appears on hover, then disappears as the pointer slowly crosses the gutter, preventing it from being grabbed.

chapters.note: Hovering reveals the handle to the left of the first paragraph.

chapters.label: Approach the handle across the gutter

chapters.note: The drag handle has disappeared during the pointer approach.
The handle is unavailable to grab; the paragraphs remain in their original order.
